title: Wayfare Pass Pause Allowances by Plan — Training Questions
content:
# Pause allowances by plan — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

**Which Wayfare Pass plans may be paused, and for how long?**

| Plan | Member may pause | Shortest pause (whole billing months) | Longest pause (whole billing months) | Pause frequency (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Student | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Wayfare Pass Monthly | yes | 1 | 3 | 12 |
| Wayfare Pass Annual | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | yes | 1 | 3 | 12 |
| Wayfare Pass Plus Annual | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**What do the columns mean?**

- *Member may pause*: whether the member may pause the membership.
- *Shortest pause* and *Longest pause*: the shortest and the longest pause, in whole billing months; 0 where pausing is not offered.
- *Pause frequency*: a new pause may begin only if no pause began within this many calendar months before; 0 where pausing is not offered.

**Can a Wayfare Pass Annual member pause?** No. Pausing is offered only on Wayfare Pass Monthly and Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly.

**What pause lengths are open on Wayfare Pass Monthly?** One, two or three whole billing months: at least 1 and at most 3.

**Hypothetical check of the frequency figure:** on Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly, a pause that began 5 calendar months ago is within the 12 calendar months, so a new pause may not begin yet; a pause that began 14 calendar months ago is outside them.
